conclusion: Supported adventure saves retain stack quantities/XP/equipment and resolve creature IDs through current library definitions. New battles enroll via explicit XP admission. Battle queries reject saving and currentBattles are absent from CGameState serialization; no supported old-midbattle restoration path is claimed. Direct forced low-level serialization is not a supported UI save and does not preserve battles.
